_comment: Overlay on the general base for the 'legal' domain. Polarity is from the view of the subject of the story (defendant/respondent), not the plaintiff; the same ruling can be good news for one side. 'positive'/'negative' entries re-file a term (removing it from the opposite list); 'neutral' drops a base term because its polarity is not stable here. STARTER lexicon, unvalidated against labelled data; extend before relying on it.
